description: This Java class demonstrates custom printing support in an Android application. It displays a list of MotoGP champions and implements a PrintDocumentAdapter to handle layout and writing of print pages, including handling page ranges, cancellation, and scaling content for printing.

classes.name: PrintCustomContent
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating custom print support with list display and PDF generation.

classes.name: MotoGpStatItem
classes.description: Data class representing a MotoGP champion's year, name, and constructor.

classes.name: MotoGpStatAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter for displaying MotoGP stats in list items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity and sets list adapter with MotoGP stats.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with print option.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, triggers print if selected.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Sets up and initiates the print process with a custom PrintDocumentAdapter.

methods.name: loadMotoGpStats
methods.description: Loads MotoGP data from resources into a list of MotoGpStatItem.

methods.name: measureView
methods.description: Measures a view's dimensions for layout purposes.

methods.name: containsPage
methods.description: Checks if a page number is within requested page ranges.

methods.name: computeWrittenPageRanges
methods.description: Computes page ranges from a set of written pages for printing.
